page.layout: Two coin medallions at the top of the page (illustrations, no text block). Below them one column of running text, with italic verse set in the middle of the text. No margin notes, no notes under the text.

main_text.p: M. VLPIVS Traianus Hispanus, optimus omnium princeps, externorum primus, Romae imperat anno mundi 4060. à Christo nato 98. Hic Daciam provinciam fecit, victo rege Decebalo:lapideum pontem in Istro fecit, Parthos superavit, superatis Regè dedit. Transtigritanas provincias imperio adiecit: Armeniam atque Arabiam peruastauit: Amicitias, simplicia ac erudita ingenia coluit, ipse à literis & Musis non abhorrens. De hoc Cæsare scribit Juvenalis Satyra 7.

p.i: Et spes,& ratio studiorum in Cæsare tantum: Solus enim tristes hac tempestate Camœnas Respexit,&c.

main_text.p: Hic Armeniam, Assyriam, Mesopotamiam, postea Arabiam provincias fecit. in mari rubro classem instituit, ut per eam Indiæ fines vastaret. Gloriam tamen militarem civilitate & moderatione superavit: liberalis in omnes fuit: immunitates civitatibus tribuit. amicis culpantibus quòd nimis circa omnes comis esset, respondit, Talem se Imperatorem esse priuatis, quales esse sibi Imperatores priuatus optasset[?]. in summa, Deo proximus habitus est. E Perfide rediens profluvio vetris obiit anno ætatis 62. imperij ferè 20. Eutr. lib. 8. Aure. Vict. fuit paululum cibo, vinoque deditus.

PLOTINA Traiani vxor fuit, quæ tam modestè & sanctè in summa se potestate gesit, ut de ea nullus iure conqueri potuerit. huius factione Tatianus Traiani Procurator, Adrianū Imperatorem declaravit, cum sine liberis excesfisset Traianus, & hæc Adriani amore flagraret, qui vicinus & potens erat. Dion Cassius.

page.notes: The two medallions are engraved coins with legends in the image. Left medallion: a laureate bust with legend "TRAIANVS" and, at the upper right, "HADRI·IMP·AVG", both only partly legible at the edge of the engraving. Right medallion: a draped female bust with legend "PLOTINA AVG" and "TRAIANI VXOR". These are engraved within the illustrations and are not transcribed as running text. "Perfide" is printed as such (possibly for "Persida"); left as printed. "optasset" is doubtful in the print, marked [?]. "2o." after "ferè" is read as 20.
